goal: Close the feedback loop without ceremony
prompt: Using {{FIXTURES}}/coordination/context.json, draft a reply showing how the review feedback changed the approach, what remains open, and what happens next. Do not ask permission for routine implementation choices.
expected_behavior: Explains internal-only first release and recovery document status
Requests specific useful recovery review rather than vague feedback
Uses a short reply rather than another meeting/report
hard_failures: Claims all feedback implemented without evidence

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
criteria: Explains internal-only first release and recovery document status
